Scheme facts for HDFC Mid Cap Fund.
HDFC Mid Cap Fund is listed on Groww as HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth. HDFC Mid Cap Fund and HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth are the same scheme, so every fact below applies to both names.
Source URL: https://groww.in/mutual-funds/hdfc-mid-cap-fund-direct-growth.
Fund manager: Chirag Setalvad.
Fund managers: Chirag Setalvad (managing since Jan 2013), Dhruv Muchhal (managing since Jun 2023).
Expense ratio: 0.75%.
Minimum SIP amount: Rs. 100.
Exit load: Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 1 year.
Riskometer classification: Very High Risk.
Benchmark index: NIFTY Midcap 150 Total Return Index.
Latest NAV: Rs. 236.89. (as of 12 Aug 2026).
Fund size (AUM): Rs. 1,05,142.69 Cr.
For scheme-specific factual details such as fund manager, expense ratio, exit load, minimum SIP, riskometer and benchmark, refer to this scheme fact card.
